name: agent-builder
description: A playbook + skill pack that helps any product manager build reliable AI agents. Gates decide if an agent is even the right tool; section-writers draft the parts a generic PRD omits — eval plan, human-in-the-loop boundaries, memory strategy, reliability + failure premortem, and a learning loop; a critic audits the result. Grounded in a full read of Orkes Conductor, the Mastra 'Principles of Building AI Agents' book, and Mastra's agent-memory research. Use when scoping, drafting, or reviewing an agent / agentic-AI product spec.
